dedupe_keys.name: paper data robust market based battery energy storage management strategy for operation in european balancing markets

description: Kārlis Baltputnis and Zane Broka of Riga Technical University provide data supporting a study of battery energy-storage operation in European balancing markets. The bundle contains frequency time series, reserve-activation records, market-price inputs, simulation settings, example outputs and post-processing files, including an Excel economic-assessment model. It covers frequency containment reserve and automatic frequency restoration reserve. The two historical cases are Germany from July 2022 through June 2023 and Finland during 2022, with additional extreme six-hour validation scenarios. Zenodo supplies one ZIP archive for free access under CC BY 4.0. The related BESS-Simulation repository provides the software, and the journal DOI identifies the supporting paper. Neither supporting identifier replaces the dataset’s native DOI. A limitation is that individual sampling intervals and the full scenario configuration are absent from the metadata. The deposited data and economic results were not executed or independently validated.
